title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Plan Entry and Requester Matrix
content:
## Plan entry and authorized requesters — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

Each Payoff and Loan Satisfaction plan is held only by a payoff case that meets that plan's entry conditions, and its terms go only to the requesters that plan allows.

### Entry conditions of each plan

| Plan | Requester | Further entry conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Borrower Voluntary Payoff | the borrower | the loan is active, in its deferral period or due and payable |
| HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | the borrower | the loan is a HECM and a new HECM case number is on file |
| Heir Retention Payoff | a successor in interest | the loan's maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure |
| Estate Market Sale Payoff | a successor in interest or the borrower | an arm's-length purchase contract is on file |
| Approved Short Sale Payoff | a successor in interest or the borrower | an arm's-length purchase contract is on file and the property has been listed at least 30 days |
| Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure | a successor in interest or the borrower | title is clear and the property is vacant |

### Requester and coverage settings

| Setting | Borrower Voluntary Payoff | HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | Estate Market Sale Payoff | Approved Short Sale Payoff | Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Who may receive the payoff statement | the borrower; an authorized third party | the borrower; a new lender holding authorization | a confirmed successor | a confirmed successor; a title company holding authorization | a confirmed successor; a title company holding authorization | a confirmed successor |
| A title company or new lender may obtain the statement with the borrower's written authorization | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| The requester must be the borrower or a confirmed successor in interest | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Loan programs the plan applies to | HECM and Summit | HECM only | HECM and Summit | HECM and Summit | HECM and Summit | HECM and Summit |
| The loan must have a maturity case that is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Largest number of open payoff cases on one loan | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

### Points of judgement

- A Summit loan (the Cedarline Summit proprietary line) can be paid off under every plan except the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff, which covers HECM loans only.
- The four plans that need a maturity case in one of the three listed statuses are the Heir Retention Payoff, the Estate Market Sale Payoff, the Approved Short Sale Payoff and the Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure; the Borrower Voluntary Payoff and the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff need none.
- On every plan one loan carries at most 1 open payoff case at a time.
